info.title: DeployHub REST API
info.description: GitHub-static deployment is the default: public repositories, pinned commits, checked static output and metadata-only persistence. All endpoints require a scoped bearer key or HttpOnly session except first-admin/login/setup and the public website resolver. Session writes require the configured dashboard Origin. Production changes require explicit authorizeProduction: true. Upload/build APIs are opt-in legacy compatibility. API rate limit is 300 requests/minute; authentication is 20 requests/15 minutes.

bearerAuth.description: Scoped dh_ API key or seven-day dhs_ session bearer token.

token.description: Seven-day session bearer token. Also returned as HttpOnly deployhub_session cookie. Treat as secret.

productionUrl.description: Stable /admin/project-slug viewer URL in GitHub-static mode; independent runtime URL in legacy mode. Active content requires a live checked deployment.

source.description: github for metadata-only public GitHub static deployments; upload/retry labels describe legacy retained source.

uploadPath.description: Empty for GitHub-static: website files are not persisted.

configuration.description: Serialized {github: GitHubStaticSource} with a pinned commit after successful resolution; legacy deployments retain build-setting overrides.

path.description: Empty for GitHub-static; legacy artifacts refer to retained local storage.

sizeBytes.description: Zero for GitHub-static because no website files are persisted.

kind.description: github-static stores routing/integrity metadata with no local website path; static/runtime are retained legacy artifacts.

runtimeContainer.description: Managed container name, not a browser URL.

runtimeEndpoint.description: Private gateway endpoint. Clients should use previewUrl/productionUrl.

WorkerCapabilities.description: A recent deployment-worker report. Reports older than 45 seconds are unavailable. This prerequisite check does not prove a particular application builds or runs.

staticUploadsAvailable.description: False in default GitHub-static mode. Upload acceptance requires legacy mode and worker processing.

dockerAvailable.description: A recent worker report confirms a reachable Linux Docker daemon.

supportedRuntimeFrameworks.description: Empty unless dynamic runtimes are reported available. Framework-specific configuration remains required.

deploymentMode.description: Default github-static; legacy explicitly restores upload/build APIs.

githubStaticAvailable.description: Recent worker availability for GitHub static verification. This does not guarantee upstream GitHub access or a particular deployment.

authorizeProduction.description: Must be true when environment is production.

repository.description: Public https://github.com/owner/repository URL. No private repositories, credentials, query string or tree/blob paths.

branch.description: Branch or commit; omitted/empty selects the repository default branch.

directory.description: Safe repository-relative directory containing browser-ready index.html and assets.

authorizeProduction.description: Must be true for production changes, after explicit user authorization.

url.description: Independent hosting origin used inside the sandboxed /admin/project viewer.

post.summary: Validate and queue a ZIP or multiple uploaded files
post.description: Legacy compatibility only: requires DEPLOYMENT_MODE=legacy. Default GitHub-static mode rejects uploads with 410 before reading multipart data; use github-deployments instead. Requires deploy scope. Defaults to preview. Production requires authorizeProduction=true. Upload success does not mean the website is live; poll GET deployments/{id}. Files are limited by configured MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, MAX_FILES and archive expansion protections. In archive mode supply exactly one ZIP. In folder mode supply repeated files fields and a paths JSON array in matching order. Optional build settings are snapshotted for this deployment and override project defaults. Ready static output can publish without a build; source/server applications require a capable Linux Docker worker. Inspect GET /capabilities and configure external service credentials before retrying source deployments. Server support does not cover every runtime or provider-specific adapter.

parameters.description: Reuses the same deployment for this user/project/key.

put.summary: Set an encrypted, environment-scoped build variable
put.description: Requires project manage scope and a configured 64-character hexadecimal ENCRYPTION_KEY. Values are AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest and injected only into the selected environment's isolated build and application runtime. HOME, PATH, NODE_OPTIONS, LD_PRELOAD, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, BASH_ENV, ENV, DOCKER_HOST and DOCKER_CONFIG are reserved. Browser output must never contain private secrets.

post.summary: Queue a new deployment from retained uploaded source
post.description: Requires project deploy scope. The original deployment must be terminal, its source retained, and the project active. Copies source into a new version and reuses deployment-specific overrides with current project defaults. Preview is the default even when the original was production. Production requires authorizeProduction:true and leaves the prior production pointer unchanged until verification. Each request creates a new version; upload idempotency-key semantics do not apply. Runtime previews require a production retry because their preview secrets/storage cannot be pointer-switched into production.

202.description: New deployment queued; poll its id for verified live or terminal failure

400.description: Invalid retry settings or missing production authorization

403.description: Project deploy scope required

404.description: Deployment unavailable or outside project authorization

409.description: Project inactive, original deployment unfinished, or retained source unavailable

post.summary: Queue a checked public GitHub static deployment
post.description: Requires deploy scope for this active project. The worker resolves the selected branch to an immutable commit, checks ready index.html/direct assets and verifies the website through its independent runtime before live status. No clone, upload, build, website artifact file or GitHub credential is retained. Preview is default and leaves production unchanged. GitHub remains an upstream serving dependency. A new branch commit requires a new deployment.

202.description: GitHub deployment queued; not live until worker verification passes.

400.description: Invalid repository, branch, directory or missing production authorization.

403.description: Deploy scope or project membership required.

404.description: Project unavailable or outside scope.

get.summary: Resolve an active checked website for the isolated viewer
get.description: Public routing metadata only. Returns no repository contents, secrets or administrator data. The project must be active and the selected production/preview deployment live. The URL must use an origin independent of the dashboard. Responses are no-store.

parameters.name: deployment
parameters.description: Checked preview deployment belonging to this project. Omit for its production pointer.
